dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe it's time to let the past go...

dialogues.speaker: Pentti
dialogues.text: Huh? You wouldn't be saying that if you knew what it was like! A night in this place was a tenth of the price it is now, and the service was ten times better!

dialogues.speaker: Pentti
dialogues.text: Ah, forget it. What's the point in talking about all this with a whipper-snapper like you? It's not like you were there to see it.
